subject.title: fix(ui): add timeout to control-ui bootstrap config fetch

question: Should the Control UI silently discard server bootstrap metadata and use defaults whenever `/control-ui-config.json` has not responded within 15 seconds?
rationale: The timeout fixes an availability problem but establishes a new startup and fallback compatibility boundary whose acceptable deadline and user-visible failure behavior require Control UI owner intent.

options.title: Require integrated proof first
options.body: Keep the 15-second proposal pending an actual Control UI bootstrap test that proves a usable fallback and preservation of metadata for responses just below the deadline.

options.title: Accept the fixed boundary
options.body: Approve the hard-coded 15-second silent fallback as intentional compatibility behavior and require the current failed checks to be resolved before merge.

options.title: Use explicit recovery UX
options.body: Replace silent fallback with a visible retry or recovery state so slow deployments do not unknowingly start with incomplete server metadata.

recommendation.title: Require integrated proof first
recommendation.body: Keep the 15-second proposal pending an actual Control UI bootstrap test that proves a usable fallback and preservation of metadata for responses just below the deadline.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal connects this person to the major Control UI application and configuration refactor that owns the affected bootstrap behavior.
